sbom.title: SBOM Ingestion
sbom.intro: Automated CI/CD pushes go directly to the SCA platform and never pass through this screen. This page covers the COTS/Vendor manual upload path, a manual trigger for the scheduled Dependency-Track sync, and the ingestion history that answers "when was this last scanned".
sbom.uploadValidationError: Select an application, enter a version, and choose a file before uploading.
sbom.uploadErrorSummary: The upload could not be completed:
sbom.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Check the file is valid CycloneDX or SPDX JSON.
sbom.uploadForwarded: Forwarded to the SCA platform for vulnerability analysis.
sbom.manualUploadHint: For Applications with no CI/CD pipeline: upload a vendor-supplied SBOM, or one your team generated from vendor-supplied source code (FR-2.6). The Application must already exist in the Inventory.
sbom.syncHint: Pulls Components and already-matched Findings from Dependency-Track into this platform's own backlog, re-tiering every Finding through the current Severity/SLA Policy. Runs automatically on a schedule; use this to force an immediate refresh.
sbom.syncFailed: Sync failed. Check the Dependency-Track connection settings.
sbom.staleHint: Flags any Application Version that has gone past the configured window (default 90 days) without a new SBOM.
sbom.historyHint: Every SBOM ingest for a given Application Version, newest first — answers "when was this last scanned" (FR-2.3).
sbom.noHistory: No ingestion history for this version yet.
